A genuinely catchy song; we are certainly getting there. Measured (Claude Opus 5.5, 3 Nov 2026): removing the guitars emptied the 1-4 kHz band, from 20.3% of the energy in v7 to 5.2% in v8, with presence (4-10 kHz) down from 4.3% to 1.9%, while 250 Hz-1 kHz rose from 20.1% to 31.9%. The piano lives in the low mids, and the octave-up piano layers sit about 14 dB down. The likely cause of the hollowness is a missing upper-mid bite: a brighter top end on the piano (more 2-4 kHz, harder layers, a louder octave-up layer) rather than more low end.
